title: 第4章 魔女入狱，点名道姓
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
接下来的几天，天牢里出奇的平静。

    就像是暴风雨前的宁静，连老鼠都不敢出来偷吃。

    陈然乐得清闲，每天除了送饭、巡逻，就是躲在狱卒房里修炼。

    有着【镇狱天书】的加持，他的日子过得比神仙还滋润。

    每天一睁眼，就是“叮，一年功力到账”。

    这种躺着变强的感觉，简直让人上瘾。

    短短五天。

    陈然体内的内气已经积攒到了一个惊人的程度。

    陈然看向系统，心念一动。

    【你已镇守天牢一日，奖励一年功力，是否领取？】

    “是”

    【你成功领取一年功力】

    【当前：5年功力】

    一股精纯功力从丹田凭空升起，向着身体四肢百骸涌去。

    这段日子来，他的修为很顺利晋升到了九品炼皮。

    虽然距离八品易筋还有很长一段距离，但只要给他一些时间，突破到八品也就是十几天功夫。

    现在的他，皮肤坚韧如牛革，单臂一晃便有五百斤力气。

    “这就是开挂的人生吗？”

    陈然看着自己的手掌，感受着体内奔涌的力量，嘴角微微上扬。

    然而，好日子总是短暂的。

    这一天傍晚。

    天牢突然戒严。

    原本昏暗的甬道里，点亮了无数火把，将整个天牢照得如同白昼。

    一队身穿飞鱼服、腰佩绣春刀的镇魔司校尉，杀气腾腾地闯了进来。

    为首一人，面容冷峻，目光如电，一看就是个狠角色。

    在他身后，是一辆由黑铁打造的囚车。

    囚车上，锁着一个红衣女子。

    那女子虽然披头散发，满身血污，但依然掩盖不住那绝世的容颜。

    尤其是那双眼睛，狭长而妩媚，仿佛藏着无尽的深渊，看一眼就能把人的魂儿勾走。

    红莲魔女！

    那个让京城无数高手闻风丧胆的魔教妖女！

    陈然混在狱卒堆里，偷偷瞄了一眼，顿时感觉心跳漏了一拍。

    就连前世经过洗礼的自己，在看到真正容貌后都被惊艳到了。

    更别说其它普通人了，恐怕魂都要被勾走了

    陈然暗自咋舌。

    不过，他也只是看看而已。

    这种级别的妖女，那是带刺的玫瑰，谁碰谁死。

    原本以为，这种重犯肯定会被关进乙字号甚至甲字号。

    可谁知，那队镇魔司校尉竟然径直朝着丁字号走来。

    “什么情况？”

    众狱卒面面相觑，一脸懵逼。

    丁字号可是关押普通犯人的地方，这尊大佛怎么往这儿送？

    还没等众人反应过来，王校尉已经屁颠屁颠地迎了上去，一脸谄媚。

    “大人，这就是丁字号七号房，最里面，安静，没人打扰。”

    为首的镇魔司校尉点了点头，冷冷地说道：

    “把人关进去，严加看管，若是出了差错，你们整个天牢都得陪葬！”

    “是是是，大人放心，下官一定亲自盯着！”
content_en:
In the next few days, the prison was surprisingly peaceful.

    It's like the calm before the storm, even the mice don't dare to come out to eat.

    Chen Ran enjoyed his leisure time. Apart from delivering meals and patrolling every day, he also hid in the jailer's room to practice.

    With the blessing of the [Prison-Suppressing Heavenly Book], his life was smoother than that of a god.

    Every day when I open my eyes, it’s like “Ding, one year’s worth of skill is here”.

    This feeling of getting stronger while lying down is simply addictive.

    Just five days.

    The inner energy in Chen Ran's body has accumulated to an astonishing level.

    Chen Ran looked at the system with a thought in his mind.

    [You have guarded Tianlao for one day and will be rewarded with one year of skill. Do you want to receive it? 】

    "Yes"

    [You successfully received one year of skill]

    [Current: 5 years of skill]

    A stream of pure power rose out of thin air from Dantian and surged towards the body, limbs and bones.

    Over the past few days, his cultivation has been successfully promoted to the ninth level of skin refining.

    Although there is still a long way to go before the eighth level Yijin, as long as you give him some time, it will take more than ten days to break through to the eighth level.

    Now, his skin is as tough as cow leather, and he has a strength of 500 kilograms with one arm.

    "Is this the life of cheating?"

    Chen Ran looked at his palms, feeling the power rushing through his body, and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.

    However, good times are always short-lived.

    This evening.

    The prison was suddenly under martial law.

    Countless torches were lit in the originally dark corridor, illuminating the entire prison like daylight.

    A group of captains from the Demon Suppression Division, wearing Feiyu uniforms and embroidered spring knives on their waists, broke in with murderous intent.

    The leader has a stern face and lightning-like eyes. He looks like a ruthless character at first glance.

    Behind him is a prison car made of black iron.

    There is a woman in red locked in the prison car.

    Although the woman's hair was disheveled and her body was covered in blood, she still couldn't hide her peerless appearance.

    Especially those eyes, which are long, narrow and charming, as if they hide endless abyss, and can draw away people's soul with just one look.

    Red Lotus Witch!

    That demon sect witch who made countless masters in the capital fearful!

    Chen Ran mingled among the jailers, took a sneak peek, and suddenly felt his heart skip a beat.

    Even I, who had been baptized in my previous life, was shocked after seeing my true appearance.

    Not to mention other ordinary people, I’m afraid their souls will be taken away.

    Chen Ran was secretly speechless.

    However, he just looked at it.

    A witch of this level is like a rose with thorns, whoever touches it will die.

    I originally thought that such a repeat offender would definitely be imprisoned in Category B or even Category A.

    But who would have expected that the team of captains from the Demon Suppression Division would actually walk straight towards the T-number.

    "What's going on?"

    All the jailers looked at each other in confusion.

    T-shaped cell is a place where ordinary prisoners are imprisoned. How to send this giant Buddha here?

    Before anyone could react, Lieutenant Wang had already rushed forward with a flattering look on his face.

    "Sir, this is the T-shaped room No. 7. It's the innermost room. It's quiet and no one will disturb you."

    The captain of the Demon Suppressing Division nodded and said coldly:

    "Lock them in and keep them under strict supervision. If something goes wrong, your entire prison will be buried with them!"

    "Yes, yes, sir, don't worry, I will definitely keep an eye on it personally!"
title_en: Chapter 4 The witch is imprisoned and named by name
